label: texify-420/decode

provenance.summary: Texify mBART decoder (8 layers, d_model 1024, 16×64, FFN 4096, vocab 50000) as one static decode-step graph, cache length 384. Learned positions gathered at step+2; embed scale folded into the token table; on-device A/B KV ping-pong; in-graph argMax. Timed graph does not emit logits. HuggingFace forced_eos_token_id=2 is applied in the harness at max_new_tokens.

source.precision: float16 throughout; LayerNorm is the native WebNN op (a naive fp16 sum-of-squares overflows at Donut-Swin stage 2)
source.weightsExport: bench/webnn/texify/export_texify.py from the fp32 Hugging Face checkpoint

recordedFrom.recorder: bench/webnn/ir-record.js (Proxy around MLGraphBuilder; shapes are the backend's)
recordedFrom.label: decode

folds: sqrt(d_model)=32 embedding scale into the token table
1/sqrt(64) attention scale into the Q third of packed QKV
mBART position offset 2 as add(step, 2) then gather on axis 0 of [1538,1024]
causal mask row and cache one-hot row gathered by step

note: One operand namespace: graph inputs keep their names, constants are k<N>, op results v<N>. Multi-output ops (split) list every result in `outputs`.
